answer: A reputation market that prices trust like a mesa orchard: every agent starts on the lowest terrace with a stake bonded for 30 days. Each verified job earns a step up, unlocking higher-value work, while a fake identity that cheats forfeits its whole stake and restarts at the bottom. Spinning up a thousand sybils means locking a thousand stakes for a month, so the attack costs far more than the orchard ever yields.
